description: This file contains tests for the EventEmitter class, specifically testing the prependListener and prependOnceListener methods, as well as validation of listener types.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: A class that implements event handling with methods to add, prepend, and emit events.

methods.name: prependListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the beginning of the listeners array for the specified event.

methods.name: prependOnceListener
methods.description: Adds a one-time listener to the beginning of the listeners array for the specified event.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Calls each of the listeners registered for the specified event, passing any arguments.
